results.name: Steven Universe: The Space Race
results.description:
I really enjoyed this episode as it had some pretty backgrounds and i also thought the spaceship and flight suit pearls costume were pretty neat! 

If you have low FPS or want a more simple view like for VR, you can try this version!: https://skfb.ly/6nFAE

I'm a sucker for night time looking maps as i enjoy setting up the sky, and playing around with sketchfabs neat options, I also modeled Pearls flight suit and included her in the ship.

The FBX files for flight suit Pearl and the Universe Mach 3 ship can be found in the SOURCE FILES zip

results.name: Hopelessness
results.description:
**How does it feel to know that this is the end?**

**There is nothing to be done, just wait and see ...**

---

You can support me by subscribing to my [Instagram](https://instagram.com/dark_igorek)🙂

---

![](https://cdna.artstation.com/p/assets/images/images/079/639/090/large/igor-oskolskiy-hopelessness.jpg?1725440100)
A little experiment in Photoshop 🙂
---

I wanted to experiment with the camera's limit settings and came up with a little scene to do it

I hope you like it, I wanted to achieve a feeling of hopelessness, doom 🙃

Thanks to the authors of these models
I used some data from them:

* Astronaut - https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/animated-floating-astronaut-in-space-suit-loop-e2c4b146e58141e4b87917456a9970b1

* Earth - https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/earth-5f9c35be31a047928eace8b415a8ee3a

results.name: Space Engineer F Rigged
results.description:
A protection suit meant for relatively hostile environment.
Good for crowds or at some distance from the camera. Nice amount of verts. One texture set.
The rig includes twist bones. Tested and works well.

The face mesh can easily be replaced, and you can utilise the face bones as well.

The helmet and backpack can be found in the catalog.
![](https://tegnemaskin.no/gfx/astrolady-04.jpg)
